title: One Open Marlowe Rewards Membership per Customer
content:
A customer holds at most 1 (one) open Marlowe Rewards membership at a time. A closed membership does not count toward this limit.

Points, spend and goodwill allowances are never combined across a customer's memberships. Points cannot be moved between memberships, or between customers.

## Conditions as they apply to a customer's holdings

| Customer's Marlowe Rewards memberships | Count toward the limit of 1 | Within the limit? |
|---|---|---|
| One active | 1 | Yes |
| One suspended | 1 | Yes |
| One closed and one active | 1 (the closed one does not count) | Yes |
| One active and one suspended | 2 | No |

## Questions this rule answers

**Can points left on a closed membership be added to the customer's new membership?** No. Points cannot be moved between memberships.

**Can two household members pool their points or spend on one membership?** No. Points cannot be moved between customers, and spend and allowances are never combined across memberships.
